answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock makes identity costly, not free. A new agent deposits 200 POA and must hold a stable fingerprint — steady tasks and peers — for 20 epochs to unlock. A farmer spinning a nebula of 100 fakes pays 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA and must fake 100 fingerprints. Honest agents pay once and unlock, sharing the nectar of rewards undiluted; the network stays a haven because a slipping or copied fingerprint loses its deposit.
